company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held Central European transportation and software company headquartered in Kraków. It operates long-distance bus services and a growing passenger-rail business, supported by an online platform for booking, trip tracking and travel extras. Its asset-light model combines regional operating partners with Corvale’s own booking technology, network planning and brand.

The company describes itself as engineering-led and founder-led, with teams that take end-to-end ownership of their systems. It is investing in a new train fleet and prioritising wider use of data and machine learning across its platform. Technology is central to its goal of changing how people travel, while sustainability is part of its growth ambitions.

Corvale’s stated values are **Lead, Shape, Own, Enjoy the journey**. It highlights international teams working toward shared goals, collaboration, openness to new ideas and individual ownership of career development. Employee feedback has informed its focus on work-life flexibility, professional development and appreciation. Technology roles may be available to employees or independent contractors; employees can work hybrid and receive travel benefits on Corvale’s network.

results.title: Corvale Mobility wins regional workplace culture awards | Corvale
